name: Booth Bandits
tagline: Handmade coasters, fresh baked goods and brand-new merch at Indiana gun shows and markets.
about: We're a small vendor table you'll find at gun shows and pop-up markets around Indiana. Everything we bring is new or made by us. Our cakes, cupcakes and cookies are baked by CJ's Cakes of Columbus, IN, a ServSafe certified home baker since 2025. CJ's also takes custom cake orders for birthdays, showers and weddings, with delivery or curbside pickup around Columbus, Seymour, Greensburg, North Vernon, Vernon, Hope, Edinburgh, Nashville and Bloomington.

admission.freeFor: Kids 12 and under get in free
admission.where: You pay the show at the front door, not us. Once you're in, walking the tables is free.
admission.note: Most county shows are $6; the big expo shows cost more. The show organizer sets the price and who gets in free.

dealerNote: We sell goods, not guns. We're a vendor at these shows, not a licensed firearms dealer, and we don't buy, sell or transfer firearms.
